# Tags Bikez - Authorized Royal Enfield Dealer

> Tags Bikez is an authorized Royal Enfield motorcycle dealership network operating across Thrissur and Palakkad districts in Central Kerala, India. We provide new motorcycle sales, test ride bookings, genuine accessories, riding gear, finance & EMI options, exchange programs, and authorized service centers.

## Business Overview
- **Name**: Tags Bikez (Tags Automobiles)
- **Role**: Authorized Royal Enfield Dealership & Service Network
- **Headquarters / Primary Showroom**: Kuriachira, Thrissur, Kerala, India
- **Phone**: +91 75949 60023
- **Email**: info.tags.tcr@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://tagsbikez.com
- **Districts Covered**: Thrissur and Palakkad (Kerala, India)
